description:
Solve a powertrain across a throttle or airspeed range, up to 25 points.

    `sweep.steps` is the NUMBER OF POINTS, not a step size: start 40, stop 100,
    steps 4 gives 40, 60, 80 and 100. One sweep beats a loop of single points.
    The points come back in `result.points` with the share URL; no second call
    is needed to read them.

PowertrainInput.description:
One powertrain, as the anonymous endpoint accepts it (spec D4).

Catalog components are referenced by their public id (``comp_…``, from
``search_components``). The propeller may instead be given as a label, which
is all the Fast model needs.

motor_id.description: Catalog motor public id, e.g. comp_2xK….
motor_id.title: Motor Id

propeller_label.description: Use instead of propeller_id to run from the printed size.

PowertrainInput.title: PowertrainInput

PropellerLabel.description:
What is printed on the propeller — all the Fast model reads.

Inches and a spoken family name, because that is how a propeller is sold and
how a user will say it. :func:`to_schema_label` turns this into the metres
and the enum ``app.schemas.simulation.PropellerLabel`` declares.

camber_pct.description: Section camber in percent. Defaults to 3.2.
camber_pct.title: Camber Pct

chord_ratio.description: Chord at 75 % radius over diameter. Give it instead of 'family' (or with family='custom'); the two cannot both be set.
chord_ratio.title: Chord Ratio

diameter_in.description: Diameter in inches, e.g. 10 for a 10x5.
diameter_in.title: Diameter In

family.description: Chord-ratio preset: 'thin electric' (0.065 D), 'sport' (0.07 D), 'slow flyer' (0.10 D) or 'multirotor' (0.11 D). Defaults to sport.
family.title: Family

pitch_in.description: Pitch in inches, e.g. 5 for a 10x5.
pitch_in.title: Pitch In

PropellerLabel.title: PropellerLabel

SweepAxis.description: A 1-D sweep axis. ``steps`` is the NUMBER OF POINTS, not a step size.
SweepAxis.title: SweepAxis
